'''Malanose city''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malanose]] in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. It was home to vaults where protoypes and replicas of thousands of [[Gree technology|Gree devices]] were kept.
